stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Hang the banner for Anthony Parnell, 36 pts and best on ground by a very comfortable margin.

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 3 big ones on holes 13, 14 & 3 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Logjam
stories.detail: 3 tied at the top on 36 - countback territory

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: 18 on the back nine after 12 on the front - flying home

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 89 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to see Peter Kane make the trip over from Nudgee GC for a hit with us.

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 3 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 3 & 4 - this is momentum

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 2, 3 & 4 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 3 threes and 5 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 5 & 6 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 8 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Speed Bump
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 14, wipe on hole 15 - the course corrects

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Was up at 3rd, now 13th - wheels wobbling

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: 2.8 soaked the lot of them and the scoreboard has the proof.
